name: nuPlan Planning Devcontainer - Configurable
postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /workspace/data /workspace/exp /workspace/nuplan-project && if [ "${NUPLAN_BOOTSTRAP_ON_CREATE:-true}" = "true" ]; then bash /workspace/nuplan-project/DevContainers/scripts/bootstrap_nuplan.sh --profile "${NUPLAN_DATA_PROFILE:-planner_mini}"; else echo 'nuPlan bootstrap disabled by NUPLAN_BOOTSTRAP_ON_CREATE=false'; fi
